questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I can make / an utility item / from this / waste paper.
questions.solution:
The erroneous segment is "**an utility item**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of the indefinite **article "an**" is incorrect in the sentence.
 
• The common rule is that we use the article **"a"** before **consonant sounds.**
 
• We use article **"an**" before **vowel sounds (a,e,i,o,u)**.
 
• But there are a few exceptions to this rule.
 
• When the pronunciation of a word where the first syllable is a vowel ends up making **a consonant sound.**
 
• We have to use the article "a" before the word.
 
• Like in the case of words that make the consonant sound "**you**" when we are pronouncing them.
 
• For example: A European, A union, A university
 
• So, the word utility makes the "**you" **sound, and hence, we need to use the article "**a**".

The correct sentence is: *I can make **a **__utility item from this waste paper.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants ______ two monkeys jumped in front of me.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**when**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the conjunction **"when**" to connect the two clauses of the sentence.
 
• "**When**" is a subordinate clause that substantiates the main clause of the sentence with additional information.
 
• Subordinating conjunction is also used to show a **cause and effect relationship.**
 
• We also "**when**" to talk about the completion of a shorter event when a longer event is still going on.
 
• The use of when implies "**at that time**". It is crucial to mark the time when an event occurred.
 
• It is also known as time-related conjunction.
 
 
• **Example**: *The phone bell rang **when **I was just about to leave the house.*
 
 

**The correct sentence is**: *Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants **when**__ two monkeys jumped in front of me.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. This ensures that the product is suitable for human use.

B. If the product is safe, the animals remain unhurt.

C. It is illegal to test unknown chemicals on people.

D. As a result, such tests are conducted on small animals.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**CDBA**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage.
 
• **Statement C **is the first sentence of the passage as it begins with the **general fact **that it is illegal to test unknown chemicals on people**. **Opening** **statements are usually general facts.
 
• **Statement D **is the next sentence as it mentions it is the **result **of the previous statement. Unknown chemical can't be tested on humans and hence, it is tested on animals.
 
• **Statement B **is the next sentence as the previous sentence mentioned **animals**. This statement mentions that a product is considered safe only if animals remain unhurt.
 
• **Statement A **is the last sentence as it has a link with the opening statement. There is a logical progression from the first sentence which said that testing of chemicals on humans is illegal to animal testing to the **safety of the product** in the aftermath of successful tests on animals

Hence, the correct sequence is **CDBA.**

**The complete passage is:* C****. It is illegal to test unknown chemicals on people. **D**. As a result, such tests are conducted on small animals.** B.** If the product is safe, the animals remain unhurt.** A.** This ensures that the product is suitable for human use.*

questions.question:
**​Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

He was __so confident then__ nothing could hinder his success.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**so confident that**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the coordinating conjunction "**then" **is incorrect.
 
• We use "then" in a sentence to mark time or talk about a sequence of events.
 
• We need to use **that as a clause** in the given sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, that as a clause after the adjective "**confident**" expresses an **opinion\feeling** about the person(subject).
 
• The speaker wants to say that this person was so confident **that **nothing could stop him from achieving success.

**The correct sentence is**: *He was **so confident that__** nothing could hinder his success.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

A little girl opened the door of the hut.

options.text: The door of the hut is opened by a little girl.
The door of the hut has been opened by a little girl.
A little girl of the hut was opened by the door.
The door of the hut was opened by a little girl.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**The door of the hut was opened by a little girl.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are some rules to keep in mind when changing a sentence from active to passive voice.
 
• The **object **in the active voice sentence becomes a **subject **in the passive voice.
 
• "**The door**" in the active voice becomes the **subject **of the sentence in the passive voice.
 
• The girl becomes **the agent** who does the action in the passive voice
 
• The given sentence in active voice is in the **past tense **so the passive voice sentence will have the structure **was/were + past participle of the verb**.

**The correct sentence is**: *The door of the hut **was opened** by a little girl.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

questions.solution:
